messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — can we move the weekly triage from Tue 09:00 -> Tue 10:00 for the next 2 weeks? infra deploy overlaps my calendar at 9:30 :calendar:
Mira: 10:00 works for me. prefer we keep it tight (30m) if possible.
Sam: 10am ok. agree on 30m — owners-only, no deep dives. saves time.
Lee: +1 for 30m. proposed compact agenda: owners -> sev/high -> quick unblock items.
Jordana: can we add a short 'PR review blockers' line? seeing several merges blocked waiting on reviews.
Alex: draft agenda below — feedback?

```
1) Quick owner round (2m each)
2) High-severity bugs / rollout risks (10m)
3) PR blockers & merge queue (6m)
4) Quick wins / follow-ups (6m)
```
Mira: looks good. on owners: can we rotate per-repo duties? e.g. runtime -> Sam, infra -> Lee for the next two cycles.
Sam: I can take runtime for the next 2 weeks. i'll post a 1-paragraph status note before the meeting.
Priya: FYI APAC folks have trouble with 10am PST. can we consider alternating one meeting a month at 16:00 PST? not urgent, just flagging.
Alex: let's do Tue 10am for the next two meetings and then reassess for a monthly rotate. Priya — can you sync with me offline about which weeks to shift?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled infra deploy in prod on Tue 09:30-10:15 (release-pipeline). See: https://ci.internal/release/789
Mira: ok deploy-bot confirms the conflict window. 10:00 is tight but still better than 09:00.
Lee: also suggest a small protocol: owners post a 24h "owner ping" in the thread with blockers. reduces surprise items in the meeting.
Jordana: agreed. i'll add a tiny PR that adds an owner-ping template comment for repos.
Alex: i'll update the calendar to Tue 10 for two occurrences, shorten to 30m, and pin the agenda doc. will add owner-rotation notes. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sam: i'll add a 3-item checklist to the agenda doc (pre-meeting notes, blocking PRs, number of hotfixes). ping me if you want to trade runtime owner.
Mira: thanks — LMK if anyone needs a swap. we should be good to keep triage lean and async-first.
Priya: thanks — i'll propose the monthly rotate dates by EOD.
Alex: perfect — closing on this. if no objections i'll push the invite changes in 15m.
Mira: no objections from me.
Lee: all good.
Jordana: good to go.
Sam: good.
